raw_content.title: how to maintain and clean silver, copper and bronze vessels
steps: firstly, adding camphor (karpura) pieces to the box of silver utensils / ornaments prevents stain.
also, avoid washing silver vessels in chlorine water.
always after washing vessels, wipe from the cloth and dry, there by prevents stain.
additionally, to prevent stains / marks, wrap silver ornaments in tissue paper or blaze cloth.
furthermore, never allow silver in touch with rubber materials like rubber band.
finally, silver vessels shine by washing with ash or milk mixed with the water.
firstly, always wash silver ornaments / utensils in hot water after the use.
also, use boiled potato water to wash silver vessels / ornaments.
additionally, washing silver vessels with toothpaste , gives good polish to it.
furthermore, soak silver ornaments in boiled water with washing soda and small piece of aluminium in it.
finally, to remove egg stains from silver, brush with salt.
firstly, wash and dry the copper vessels after use.
also, washing copper vessels with pitambari, tamarind and ash gives a bright colour.
additionally, don’t over heat copper vessels as they might stick to bottom.
furthermore, never use harsh chemicals to clean copper vessels.
finally, never soak copper vessels in water for long period of time as they might get rust.
firstly, wash copper vessels with half lemon and salt to remove rust.
also, copper vessels shine by washing with orange, ash and also salt.
additionally, apply the paste of 1 tsp salt, 1 cup vinegar, and flour to copper utensils, leave for about half an hour and wash.
furthermore, if the copper vessels stick to bottom, wash it with water and dry it under sun.
finally, rub lime juice with salt, wash with hot water, wipe with soft cloth and also dry it.
